pages.text: $(bold)The Moon — Entry Point to Space$(/bold)$(br)Difficulty: $(bold)7.0x$(/bold) (comparable to End Outer Islands)$(br)Death Penalty: $(bold)22%$(/bold)$(br2)Your first extraterrestrial destination. No oxygen, low gravity, a stark landscape of Moon Stone and Moon Sand. Moderate hostile mobs patrol the surface.

$(bold)Low Gravity Combat$(/bold)$(br)The Moon's reduced gravity changes combat significantly:$(br)• $(bold)Knockback is doubled$(/bold) — hits send you and mobs flying$(br)• $(bold)Fall damage is halved$(/bold) — you float down gently$(br)• Projectiles travel further$(br2)Melee builds need to close distance constantly. Ranged builds thrive here.

$(bold)What to Bring$(/bold)$(br)• Space suit with oxygen$(br)• Building materials for a temporary base$(br)• Oxygen Loader + RF power source$(br)• Mining tools for Moon Stone$(br2)$(bold)What to Mine$(/bold)$(br)Moon-specific ores and materials are required for the $(bold)Tier 2 Rocket$(/bold) to reach Mars. Explore the lunar surface structures for additional loot.
